scope: Bounded sharing of repetitive internal fact metadata across scan and live-index restoration; JSON, contracts, current database and ledger identities preserved

algorithm.storage: Arc<str> for repeated measurement/operation metadata; unique record IDs, timestamps, paths and values remain independent
algorithm.sharing: Standard HashSet full string equality; at most 4096 entries and 1048576 retained UTF-8 bytes per pool, plus table overhead; individual strings over 1024 bytes bypass sharing
algorithm.overflow: Preserve full original value; continue sharing already known entries; do not truncate, discard or merge ledger records
algorithm.lifetime: Parser pool retained with source cache; temporary restoration pools released after reading; no global pool or new body retention
algorithm.work: One bounded lookup per selected field, expected linear in record count and selected text bytes; no historical prefix search
algorithm.persistence: No new version or layout, compatibility, migration or dependency

cases: Pool entry and byte-budget exhaustion and oversized Unicode preserve exact contents
Equal metadata shares storage while model/provider/apiProvider values remain distinct
Mutation leaves prior revision and serialized facts unchanged
Existing current-layout restart, corrections, alternate identities, source ownership and CLI/Web totals pass
verification.browser: No UI changes or new browser acceptance in this increment

baseline.correctness: Initial truth: 11000000 tokens and 26.500000 USD across 1 pricing-input groups. Each append contributes 110 tokens and 0.000265 USD; usage and threads agree.
baseline.conditions: Release core; new SQLite index; filesystem caches uncontrolled; indexBytes includes all product data and live WAL before idle exit, dataBytesAfterIdleExit includes settled product data; logical file lengths, not filesystem allocated blocks; peak RSS is the maximum resident size reported by time for the service; no raw-body persistence; not a 24-hour or million-record acceptance.
